# Source-generated migration fixtures

Generated by `scripts/migration/oracle.py` from retained source commit
`13b6d9c6973281fe123353eaec05b29d65781a2d` using Python3.13.15.
Each document contains source hashes/runtime and a nonempty seam case list.
Expected outcomes are executed source API results, not assertions transcribed
alongside Rust implementation. The embedded device and field-policy catalogs
are exported by the same tool into `engine-rust/src/`.

All profile names, usernames, passwords, plaintexts, salts, ciphertexts, hosts
and timestamps here are deliberately generated test inputs, not real credentials
or user data. Fernet fixture IV/time are fixed only inside the source harness;
production native encryption remains independently randomized. Conversion
freezes the original dataclass factory clock before execution rather than
normalizing differing timestamps after comparison.

CI `scripts/migration/verify_oracles.py` regenerates and compares values, hashes
and source inventory. Drift fails; interpreter-version provenance alone can be
compared across supported versions without hiding payload/side-effect changes.
These are pure/synthetic seam fixtures. They do not certify complete storage
recovery, native process ownership, browser adapters or application migration.
